Restaurant finder

One in five is starred. About 19.5% of listings hold at least one star, and 161 hold three.

France leads, Japan is denser. France has the most starred restaurants (646); Japan has fewer (358) but a 31.7% star share, and Tokyo (158) out-stars Paris (123).

Price separates star from no star, not 2★ from 3★. 94–96% of two- and three-star restaurants sit in the top price tier against 64% of one-star ones; within starred restaurants the correlation is only ρ = 0.25.

Cuisine and wine lists travel with stars. Creative cooking is starred 65% of the time; restaurants with an interesting wine list are starred at 48.5% versus 13.3% without.

Data: Michelin Guide listings from the open ngshiheng/michelin-my-maps dataset (~20k restaurants), a larger, more recent relative of the Kaggle “Michelin Restaurants” 2019 files. Counts reflect the scrape date. Green Star flags are incomplete in the source (none recorded for France, for example), so treat that count as a lower bound.
